name: Breakup Simulator
source:
In your previous life, you were a love frustrated College Girl in your mid-twenties.

After going through multiple relationships, you had enough love and wanted to focus on yourself and your friends.

In an attempt to once again convince you of the wonders of love, your friend gave you a Dating Sim.

But having had enough of it all, you didn't even try it.

Then one day, waking up from your sleep you realize something is off:

You got reincarnated as the heroine of the dating sim your friend gave you.

Your wish to avoid romance stays the same; under normal circumstances, that wouldn't be a problem.

But... the dating sims your friend plays were always the weird kind!

How will you deal with the troubles of weird, creepy, nerdy, and maybe even downright psychopathic guys trying to flirt with you?  Will you be able to scare them off or only make it worse for yourself?

Find out for yourself!

[from [url=https://adamakuto.itch.io/breakup-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
前世，你是個二十五歲上下、情場失意的女大學生。

經歷多段感情後，你已經厭倦愛情，只想專注於自己與朋友。

為了再次讓你相信愛情的美好，朋友送給你一款戀愛模擬遊戲。

但你早已受夠這一切，連試都沒試。

直到某天，從睡夢中醒來，你發現事情不對勁：

你竟轉生成了朋友送來的戀愛遊戲女主角。

你依舊不想談戀愛。正常情況下，這不會是什麼問題。

可……朋友玩的戀愛遊戲，一向都很奇怪！

古怪、嚇人、宅氣，甚至可能根本就是精神變態的男人，紛紛前來搭訕，你該如何應付？你能把他們嚇跑，還是只會讓自己的處境更糟？

親自來看看吧！

[摘自[url=https://adamakuto.itch.io/breakup-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
